remarks: Hamptons-Inspired Elegance in Waterfront Lucas Point Experience the ease of coastal living just one hour from New York City in the coveted private waterfront association of Lucas Point in Old Greenwich. Residents enjoy an exceptional lifestyle anchored by a private sandy beach, dock, and boat storage, while the neighborhood's charming privet-lined lanes foster a true sense of community--where neighbors gather on their porches to share conversation and watch the evening sunset. A ''Coastal Shingle Style Residence'', 2016 HOBI Award winning home, designed by noted Greenwich Architect Steven Mueller, sits atop one of the highest elevations in Lucas Point, on one of the neighborhood's largest properties.
